Setting remove_navigation to false preserves nav and aside elements

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"preprocessing\":{\"remove_navigation\":false}}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<nav>SiteMenu</nav><main><p>MainContent</p></main><aside>SidebarText</aside>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
